name: the-floating-capsule-fills-as-a-page-loads
description: The sidebar hides its address row while the floating capsule is up, so the capsule carries the load instead. Cmd+Shift+D floats it, then a Cmd+R reload is read on the /devbar document. Reading the sidebar here would say nothing: the two address bars are separate documents and never both visible, so only the capsule's own fill layer proves the push reached both surfaces.

actions.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.devbar .loadfill'); if (!el) { return 'no fill'; } return el.classList.contains('waiting') || el.classList.contains('receiving') ? 'still filling ' + el.className : 'clear'; })()
actions.note: THE CONTROL: nothing is loading, so nothing fills.

actions.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.devbar .loadfill'); if (!el) { return 'no fill'; } const bar = el.parentElement; const w = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).width); const full = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(bar).width); if (!full) { return 'no capsule'; } const live = el.classList.contains('waiting') || el.classList.contains('receiving'); if (!live) { return 'idle ' + el.className; } const pct = w / full; return pct > 0.02 && pct <= 1.001 ? 'filling' : 'off ' + pct.toFixed(2); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.devbar .loadfill'); if (!el) { return 'no fill'; } const o = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).opacity); return el.classList.contains('done') && o < 0.02 ? 'faded' : 'still showing ' + el.className + ' ' + o.toFixed(2); })()

assertions.desc: the chord floated the bar, so the state under test was reached
THE CONTROL: an idle capsule carries no live phase.
THE MEASUREMENT: the same push that fills the docked field fills the capsule, in the other document.
the capsule hands back to its plain plate once the page arrives.
